description_excerpt: Job Description To maintain lab equipment, both in Textile and FW sections on a daily basis. To check and perform verification, follows lab verification plan in compliance with the requirements of ARL-08. To coordinate with Lab Admin to review quotations related to equipment fixing. To coordinate with Lab team Leaders to check and submit equipment calibration list quarterly. To set up and prepare facilities for installing new equipment.
